liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias - Fire On The Mountain** (3 reviews): The transition between Jerry and Brent was highlighted as a sweet moment; Jerry's voice and guitar playing were described as truly memorable for this stint [35][36][38]
- **All Over Now** (1 review): Brent's performance was energetic, featuring nice scat singing throughout the track [37]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): The performance of Estimated Prophet lasted approximately sixteen minutes [34]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): The drums and space flowed into one of the best Wheels the reviewer has heard [28]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-04-13.109288.beyer-senn.daweez.D5scott.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 22 songs; 150 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd84-04-13.sbd.miller.27733.sbeok.flacf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 156 min; rated 3.92/5 by 13 [4]. Said about its sound: The recording features notable vocal effects at the end of the song [34]
- **gd1984-04-13.164369.neumann.u87.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [7]
- **gd1984-04-13.157541.aud.carpenter.flac2448**: audience recording; 19 songs; 151 min [9]
- **gd1984-04-13.155699.fob.neumann.U87.cm.eaton.miller.t.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [10]
- **gd84-04-13.fob-eaton.21130.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 20 songs; 152 min; rated 4.35/5 by 17 [11]. Said about its sound: The recording features a rolling reverb effect at the end of the song; An echobox effect was used, creating a loose sound on the recording [35][38]
- **gd84-04-13.aud-neumann.pj.1521.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 144 min; rated 3.91/5 by 11 [17]. Said about its sound: The recording features a rolling reverb effect at the end of the song [36]

## Around the show

- Low lights and a laid-back crowd lying around made the venue feel like a living room [27]
- Mickey left his drum set with the talking drum to stand next to Jerry [29]
- A man on the floor had a commotion, bleeding and urinating, requiring removal [29]
- A perfect circle appeared in the clouds above the coliseum after the show ended [30]
- The weather was described as hot, sweaty, and steamy during the performance [30]
- A clear moon circle in the clouds was visible outside after the show [32]
- Hampton Coliseum was noted as a long-standing, friendly venue for the band [32]
- The second set fell apart after the transition into Fire On The Mountain [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-04-13.109288.beyer-senn.daweez.D5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 3 Beyer M160's (up front) > custom made blend box> Sony TC-D5M (Dolby on) - analog master cassettes; [1]. Also: The recording is dedicated to Sandy, a friend of the uploader known as Bigfoot [1]
- **gd84-04-13.sbd.miller.27733.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac16 SBD> Cassette Master> Cassette> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k), plus patches from Eaton FOB Neumann U87> Cass source; [4]
- **gd1984-04-13.164369.neumann.u87.eaton.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Rob Eaton, Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Rob Eaton's Master (FOB)(DFC) Audience Cassettes; Neumann U87 mics > Sony D5M [7]. Also: A Sennheiser 441 source supplied a ten-second patch in the Drums track [7]
- **gd1984-04-13.157541.aud.carpenter.flac2448**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Ted Carpenter; source: unknown mics -> Marantz pdm360 - no dolby Maxell XL-IIS 90s [9]. Also: Rob Eaton and Charlie Miller helped complete the sets, with channels swapped for stereo; Patches were added for tape flips and connectors to smooth song transitions [9]
- **gd1984-04-13.155699.fob.neumann.U87.cm.eaton.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Recorded and Transferred by Rob Eaton; transferred by Mastered by Charlie Miller  January 6, 2022; source: (FOB) Neumann U87 > Cassette Master (Nakamichi 550) [10]. Also: Rob Eaton transferred his recordings, with patches provided by Doug Lamarre and Scott Clugston; Joe B. Jones checked the pitch of the recording [10]
- **gd84-04-13.fob-eaton.21130.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Rob Eaton; source: Rob Eaton FOB Center (Neumann U89)>Sony TC-D5>DAT>CDR>EAC>SHN [11]
- **gd84-04-13.aud-neumann.pj.1521.sbeok.shnf**: source: Neumann U-87 mics > Sony D6 cass > Dat > CDR [17]
